"''And cover all that beautiful machinery?|The Modifier responds to Boba Fett after fixing Fennec Shand|}} "'''The Modifier'''"{{Databank|the-modifier|The Modifier}} was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[cyborg]] who worked in the [[Mos Eisley Mod Parlor]] on [[Tatooine]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. An artisan with [[Cybernetics|cybernetic augmentation]], the skilled craftsman engineered customized additions and improvements for anyone with money, and the parlor was visited by members of the [[Mods]] gang who came to upgrade or replace their cybernetic components.{{Databank|mos-eisley-mod-parlor|Mos Eisley Mod Parlor}} When ex-[[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] carried the unconscious [[Master Assassin]] [[Fennec Shand]] into the Mod Parlor, the Modifier agreed to his request to save her life by adding cybernetics parts to her body, taking Fett's [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] as payment to modify Shand's abdomen. He later came to [[Boba Fett's Palace]] to attend to a wounded [[Cobb Vanth]] in Fett's [[bacta tank]].{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}} {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The Modifier first appeared in "[[Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm]]," the fourth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', which was directed by [[Kevin Tancharoen]] and released on [[January 19]] [[2022]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-january-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in January 2022}} He was played by [[Stephen Bruner]], aka Thundercat. ==Appearances== *[[The Book of Boba Fett Junior Novel|''The Book of Boba Fett'' Junior Novel]] *{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}} {{1st}} {{Flash}} *{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/the-book-of-boba-fett-cargo-hold-chapter-4|text=''The Book of Boba Fett'' Cargo Hold: "Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm"}} {{Po}} *{{DisneyGallery|Disney Gallery: The Book of Boba Fett|The Book of Boba Fett}} *{{ToppsLivingSet|num=386|cardname=The Modifier|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/382562/cid/20614688/2023-Topps-Living-Star-Wars-386-The-Modifier}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|mos-eisley-mod-parlor|Mos Eisley Mod Parlor}} {{Po}} *{{Databank|the-modifier|The Modifier}} {{1stID|the Modifier}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=El Modificador |ja=改造屋 |ka=მოდიფიკატორი }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Modifier, the}} [[Category:Cyberneticists]] [[Category:Cyborgs]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Members of the Fett gotra]] [[Category:Tatooinians]]
